title: Multi-Seq: Clean Nuclei Preparation Protocol
author: Luciano G Martelotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbq6imze
materials: In the final wash resuspend in 80 µL of chilled Wash Buffer supplemented with 0.2 U/μl - 0.5 U/μl of RNAse Inhibitor (Protector RNAse Inhibitor, Cat. RNAINH-RO, Merck/Roche). One may use RNAse inhibitor all the way, but it becomes expensive. I use RNAse Inhibitor during cell lysis, and in this final resuspension and RNA/cDNA quality looks good.
Count using Countess II Automated Cell Counter.

steps.title: Prepare clean nuclei
steps.instruction: Obtain clean nuclei preparations to prevent CMO binding to debris.

substeps.instruction: Use either a sucrose gradient or Fluorescence-Activated Nuclei Sorting (FANS) based on DNA content staining with DAPI, 7-AAD, or DRAQ-7.

Visually inspect nuclei under a brightfield optical microscope (40x-60x magnification) before and after sorting to check for intact edges and ensure there is no chromatin popping out or nuclei blebbing.

steps.title: Prepare Anchor and Barcoded oligo mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10x stock solution of the duplex by mixing Anchor and Barcoded oligos.

substeps.instruction: Mix Anchor and Barcoded oligos in a 1:1 molar ratio in PBS (no Ca2+/Mg2+) to a concentration of 0.8 µM.
Incubate the mix at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and sort nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend and sort the desired number of nuclei (e.g., ~100,000 nuclei).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in Washing Buffer [PBS (no Ca2+/Mg2+) + 1% BSA (MACS BSA Stock Solution from Miltenyi, Cat. 130-091-376)].
If using FANS, sort ~140,000 events (accounting for ~40% offset) into 50 µL of Washing Buffer in a 96-well culture plate (round bottom) or 1.5 mL LoBind eppis tube.
If FANS is not used, resuspend nuclei directly in 180 µL Washing Buffer.

steps.title: Wash and concentrate nuclei
steps.instruction: Transfer sorted nuclei to a 1.5 mL LoBind eppis tube and adjust volume.

substeps.instruction: Transfer nuclei to the tube and complete the volume to ~180 µL using chilled Wash Buffer (use additional volume to wash the sorting well if nuclei numbers are limited).

steps.title: Label with Anchor-Barcode oligo
steps.instruction: Add the Anchor-Barcode oligo to the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 umol of Anchor-Barcode oligo (10 µL of 0.8 µM solution for 100,000 nuclei) to reach a final volume of ~190 µL.
Mix gently but thoroughly using a wide-bore tip.

steps.title: Label with Co-Anchor oligo
steps.instruction: Add the Co-Anchor oligo to the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 umol Co-Anchor and mix gently but thoroughly (bringing final volume to 200 µL).

steps.title: Wash nuclei
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove unbound oligos.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of chilled Wash Buffer and mix by inverting 3 times.
Remove supernatant, leaving ~20-30 µL behind to avoid losing the nuclei pellet.
Repeat the wash 2 more times using 1.2 mL of chilled Wash Buffer per wash, without resuspending the nuclei between washes.

steps.title: Count and pool nuclei
steps.instruction: Verify nuclei count and prepare for multiplexing.

substeps.instruction: If possible, count nuclei using a Countess II Automated Cell Counter with Trypan Blue or Ethidium Homodimer.
Combine nuclei from multiple samples to multiplex.
Filter the combined nuclei through a 40-um Flowmi® Cell Strainer.
